model_output.rationale: All three lines carry CO-22. The 271 for the DOS shows EB*R for Novitas Medicare Part B with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." The claim was filed to Liberty Bell as primary (SBR*P). Medicare must be billed first; Liberty Bell is secondary.

root_cause.explanation: CARC 22 on all lines. 271 EB*R loop names Novitas Medicare Part B as primary payer for DOS 2026-01-29. Claim was filed to Liberty Bell as primary (SBR*P*18*CI).

next_action.detail: Bill Novitas Medicare Part B (payer ID 1846349352) as primary. After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Liberty Bell as secondary with Medicare's EOB/835 data in the 2320 COB loop.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*22 on all three service lines; claim paid $0.
EB*R loop identifies NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B FFS with MSG 'PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER' effective 2024-01-01.
SBR*P*18*CI — claim filed to Liberty Bell as primary with filing indicator CI.
CARC 22 → resubmit_other_payer; bill true primary then rebill this payer as secondary.

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; coverage exists, only the order is wrong.
next_action ladder: CARC 22/109 → resubmit_other_payer, never appeal a disclaiming payer.
